first_name.description: First name of the Party Person

last_name.description: Last name of the Party Person

name.description: Full name of the Party Person

user_id.description: User ID of the login account associated with this party person.

is_employee.description: Whether this party person is an employee of the current company, as opposed to an external vendor contact.

employee_id.description: Employee ID string for this party person. Null if no employee ID is assigned.

login.description: Email address (login) of the party person's user account.

id.description: Unique identifier of the vendor company this party person belongs to.

name.description: Name of the vendor company this party person belongs to.

number.description: Sequential number assigned to the Action Plan within its project.

id.description: Unique identifier of the Action Plan type.

active.description: Whether this type is enabled for use. When false, it is hidden from selection when creating new plans or templates.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the type was created. ISO 8601 format.

name.description: Localized display name of the Action Plan type.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the type was last modified. ISO 8601 format.

source_key.description: System key identifying a built-in type. Null for user-created custom types.

id.description: Unique identifier of the plan status.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the status was created. ISO 8601 format.

global.description: Whether this is a system-wide status available to all companies. Global statuses cannot be deleted.

name.description: Display name of the plan status (e.g., 'In Progress', 'Closed').

status.description: Underlying status type category. Custom company statuses map to one of these base types.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the status was last modified. ISO 8601 format.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Action Plan Approver. Use as the {plan_approver_id} path parameter to manage the approver's signature.

plan_id.description: ID of the Action Plan this approver is assigned to. Use as filters[plan_id] to list approvers for a specific plan.

updated_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this approver record was last updated. Use with filters[updated_at] to retrieve recently changed approvers.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Action Plan receiver assignment.

plan_id.description: ID of the Action Plan this receiver is assigned to. Use as the plan_id filter when listing receivers for a specific plan.

updated_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this receiver assignment was last updated.

private.description: Whether the Action Plan is restricted to participants only. When true, only the manager, approvers, receivers, and assigned users can view the plan.

status.description: Display name of the current plan status. Default values are draft, in_progress, and closed. Companies may define custom status names that map to underlying status types.

status_type.description: Underlying status type category for this plan's status.

template_id.description: Identifier of the Action Plan Template this plan was created from. Null if not created from a template.

total_item_count.description: Total number of plan items in this Action Plan, regardless of status.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Action Plan was last modified. ISO 8601 format.

modified_at.description: Timestamp of when the Asset was last modified
